item.title: Solved: How to Create a New User in MySQL and Grant Full Access to One Database
item.description: Creating a new user in MySQL and granting them full access to a specific database is an essential task when managing MySQL users and permissions. Whether you are setting up a test environment or managing production-level databases, knowing the right syntax and procedures can save you time and effort. In this article, we will explore multiple methods to create a user and grant access to a specific database in MySQL.

item.title: Solved: How to Fix 'Can't Connect to Local MySQL Server Through Socket' Error
item.description:
Are you facing the notorious MySQL error: “Can’t connect to local MySQL server through socket ‘/var/mysql/mysql.sock’”? This error message often shows up when trying to connect to MySQL, and it can occur due to a range of issues, from configuration mismatches to file permissions.

This article will walk you through several solutions, complete with example code, to help you fix this issue. Each approach addresses different potential causes, so try each one until you resolve your MySQL connection problem.
